title: Scalar compatibility of the actual projective-line adjunction counit
statement:
Fix a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ and a prime $\ell\ne p$. All schemes below are separated and finite type over $k$, and all maps are $k$-morphisms [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let $A\to B$ be a unital map of finite commutative rings killed by powers of $\ell$, and choose $N=\ell^n\geq1$ annihilating both. On small ordinary etale sites use constant-ring module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] and $T_T=(-)_B=-\otimes^L_{A_T}B_T$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Write $D^b_{ctf}$ for bounded constructible complexes of finite Tor amplitude, as in [det-sp-et-proet-adjunction-transfer], and $R_T(1)=\mu_{N,T}\otimes_{(\mathbf Z/N)_T}R_T$ for $R=A,B$ [lem-asd-finite-etale-twist-line]. For a standing base $S$, set $q:P=\mathbf P^1_S\to S$, $F_R=Rq_{*,R}$ and $G_R=q_R^*(-)\otimes_R^LR_P(1)[2]$. Use the actual adjunction $F_R\dashv G_R$ with counit $\epsilon_R$ and projection-formula normalization of [lem-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-adjunction]. Let $\beta_q:T_SF_A\to F_BT_P$ be the fixed proper coefficient map [lem-sp-et-proet-coefficient-compatibility]. Let $a_K:T_PG_AK\xrightarrow{\sim}G_BT_SK$ be the canonical tensor/pullback, Tate and shift comparison [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. Then for every $K\in D^b_{ctf}(S_{et},A)$,
$$\epsilon_{B,T_SK}\,F_B(a_K)\,\beta_q(G_AK)=T_S(\epsilon_{A,K}).$$
In particular $a_K$ is the mate of $\beta_q^{-1}$ on these finite-Tor subcategories.
